note: Rue des Écus place 3/4; landmark: covered glass-and-iron arcade roof over a mosaic floor (galerie couverte), glazed doorway at the far end. Repainted as a covered passage (look-alike fix vs seg002). Five verbs (data). The parked red van is scenery cut by the left edge; the revendiquer box covers the man, key and flag. Girl at the upper window: hair top ~5% from the top edge. No -er/-ir markers, no painted text.
